doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Playing for the Zulus in 1949 with Young Tuxedo
summary: He played in the street behind Louis Armstrong's Zulu float with the Young Tuxedo band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, what about when Louis was king of the Zulus in 1949?

Yeah, we were playing in, we were on the streets, too, at the time. We were playing for, playing. Were you playing for the Zulus? Yeah, yeah, I happened to be behind the floating whiskey, behind what it happened.
Yeah, and whose band was that?
Cassie. The Young Tuxedo. The Young Tuxedo. Oh, I see. What are some of the other dance bands you played with?
